27:77.text: is a guide and a mercy for the believers.

27:78.text: Verily, your Lord will decide between them
by His Judgement. And He is the All-Mighty, the All-Knowing.

27:79.text: So put your trust in Allâh; surely, you

27:80.text: Verily, you cannot make the dead to hear nor can you make the deaf to hear the call
(i.e. benefit them and similarly the disbelievers)
, when they flee, turning their backs.

27:81.text: Nor can you lead the blind out of their error. You can only make to hear those who believe in Our Ayât
(proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.)
(themselves to Allâh in Islâm as Muslims)

27:82.text: is fulfilled against them, We shall bring out from the earth a beast
for them, to speak to them because mankind believed not with certainty in Our Ayât
(Verses of the Qur’ân and Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)

27:83.text: the Day when We shall gather out of every nation a troop of those who denied Our Ayât
(proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.)

27:84.text: (before their Lord at the place of reckoning)
, He will say: "Did you deny My Ayât
(proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.)
whereas you comprehended them not by knowledge
was it that you used to do?"

27:85.text: will be fulfilled against them, because they have done wrong, and they will be unable to speak

27:86.text: See they not that We have made the night for them to rest therein, and the day sight-giving? Verily, in this are Ayât
(proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.)

27:87.text: the Day on which the Trumpet will be blown - and all who are in the heavens and all who are on the earth, will be terrified except him whom Allâh will
. And all shall come to Him, humbled.

27:88.text: And you will see the mountains and think them solid, but they shall pass away as the passing away of the clouds. The Work of Allâh, Who perfected all things, verily He is Well-Acquainted with what you do.
